name: agent-picker-cleanup
goal: One shared picker dialog preserves model and effort behavior; dead counted CSS and unreachable HubView stay retired.

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: At c7677eea both compact pickers duplicate native dialog lifecycle and CSS. No counted markup consumer exists. HubView has only branding-test references and no production importer; legacy redirects target the live Harness console. Preserve current visible behavior and selection/focus contracts.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test that faithfully reproduces the defect; record proof.
steps.evidence: Unchanged c767 product, bun x vitest run test/agent-picker-cleanup.test.ts: five fail and two pass. Duplicated picker lifecycle/import ownership, unused counted style, active HubView source and stale branding scope all fail for the intended reasons. Log /tmp/ui-picker-cleanup-red.log. Test assertions frozen after preflight scope narrowed to the two picker import graphs.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Generate ChoiceDialog once in desktop; model and effort retain choice logic and feed snippets plus dimensions. Shared owner handles selected enabled focus, Escape isolation, backdrop, restoration and CSS. Remove unused counted rules; remove unreachable HubView and officially retire its identity; update only obsolete brand surface entries. Keep existing browser contracts unchanged.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: Actual Opus5.5/xhigh same SID4f91 authored ChoiceDialog and both consumers plus dead CSS removal; official units retire preserves HubView tombstone after source removal. Only obsolete branding test/scope entries removed. Generated/indexed shared dialog and scenario binding; registry valid. Normal desktop unit entrypoint includes the frozen guard.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Same frozen test SHA e8e7cb98914e214781373c83ab8ac00c5e1386516c31d522e29d09b3eadd7d19: seven tests pass in 846ms; product repair only, assertions unchanged from red. Registry check valid1241/52existing uncertain. Broader browser/type/full checks remain pending resource window.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: Isolated git archive c767 plus exact repair and same frozen guard. Four faithful mutations individually reintroduce old picker sources (2 failures), old counted CSS (1), HubView source/active manifest (1), obsolete branding surfaces/scope (1); each exits1 on intended assertions. Restore repair: all7pass. Receipt /tmp/ui-picker-cleanup-guard-receipt.json; checkout sources never mutated.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and keep pending while proof fails.
steps.evidence: Exact54cb unmodified bun run check passed3470 tests, including198browser cases. Immutable35d4502a passed1040 checks/33scenarios; fresh inspected picker screenshots retained. Actual Opus approved three exact dialog baselines and remaining styles; native user profile preserved.
